title: cocculus miersiana
intro: Cocculus miersiana, commonly known as the "snake berry", is a plant species in the family Menispermaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cocculus miersiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cocculus miersiana include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
